The mining crew reaches a massive milestone by hauling in $1.1 million worth of gold, pushing them nearly halfway toward their towering $2.4 million seasonal target. But just as the operation hits top gear, disaster strikes—the rich paydirt cut completely runs out. With expensive machinery burning fuel and the mining season ticking away, the team faces an urgent crisis. Watch the high-stakes decisions and desperate maneuvers as they are forced to shift direction and gamble on unproven ground to keep the gold dream alive.
Watch Gold Rush Season 7, Episode 7 on Discovery Channel India.
